snippet.title: Tashio Tempo - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore a world filled with corrupted creatures. Focus your mind to cast spells that affect the environment. Wear different tunics for their magical effects, and master playing the Lute in this top-down Game Boy inspired adventure.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://steam.tashio.dev
Play on the web: https://tashio.dev
